gaps: Cost forecasting suite — EAC (BAC/CPI), ETC, TCPI, projected overrun in $, and a forward month-by-month cashflow forecast; today only CPI and the planned S-curve shape exist.

Earned-schedule SPI(t) — a time-based schedule-performance index and trend that stays reliable late in the job when cost-based SPI drifts toward 1.0; today only cost-based SPI and delay-in-working-days exist.
Monetary delay costing — prolongation / extended-preliminaries cost per day and total; delay is quantified in working days only.
Value/cost exposure per milestone and the $ of planned value pushed past the original finish date.
Contingency and margin burn tracked separately from BAC.
Acceleration pricing inside the what-if engine — it moves dates P6-exact but does not cost crashing / overtime / shifts.
Automatic least-cost crash optimization (time-cost tradeoff across the network); today only manual what-ifs.

Automatic resource leveling to a crew cap and its schedule impact; resource over-allocation / double-booking detection; trade-stacking and spatial congestion by area and time (area-by-time occupancy on the driving path).

HSE-aware scheduling — hold-points and permit-to-work sequencing (scaffold erect-then-inspect, confined-space entry, heavy-lift exclusion windows); constructability can flag missing/illogical safety sequencing but there is no HSE-specific analysis.

Live on-site roster feed to reconcile planned crew vs actual mobilized headcount; local labour and plant market availability; physical site capacity (access, welfare, laydown, parking) versus peak workforce.
Probabilistic / Monte-Carlo risk ranking of near-critical paths, free-float (vs total-float) breakdown per activity, and standing float-threshold alerts across updates.
Redundant / duplicate relationship detection in the logic audit.

Contract notice-deadline tracking (FIDIC 20.1/8.4) against correspondence, per-event causation/responsibility tagging, and a pacing-vs-culpable determination — today the tool gives concurrency and cause indicators, never fault or entitlement.

Formal contract-date ingest — comparing forecast finish and sectional/interim milestones against the contractual obligation dates directly (today the tool reads P6 milestone constraints, not the contract dates themselves).
Baseline-revision governance — link each change to its change-order/approval, per-edit author and timestamp audit trail, and compliance testing against the client's schedule specification.
Submittal-register and procurement/PO/expediting-log ingestion, plus missing-activity suggestions for procurement/engineering scope (missing-activity is currently construction/execution-only).
Automatic red-amber-green project-health scoring as a shipped control.
In-app cross-project portfolio comparison and liquidated-damages / penalty exposure computation against contract terms (portfolio served by the in-progress Power BI dashboards).
EOT Claim Builder (impacted XML + FIDIC claim) and quantity-driven Duration & Resource Calculation are in progress, not yet shipped.
